description: §38.10.2 clean neg — `onclient:*` calls with one argument (the event binding) or none compile with no E-CHANNEL-005. The delta from `channel/handler-onclient-arity` is the argument count.
rationale: §38.10.1: the parameter name in the call expression is bound to the event object; with no parameter the event object is not passed. Zero or one argument is the whole well-formed set.
